editorial:
Imagine getting a phone call from your child's school, but instead of a bad grade, you find out your kid was a bully who drove a classmate to end his own life. That is exactly how this tense drama kicks off. You get to watch a group of wealthy, arrogant parents gather in one room, all trying to protect their kids' futures while avoiding the truth. The vibe is super stressful because you can feel the tension rising as these parents turn on each other. It is not just about the tragedy, but about how far people will go to keep their social status and money safe from a scandal.

The acting is top-notch and makes you really hate some of these people, which is a sign of a great performance. The story moves quickly and keeps you guessing about who was actually the worst bully in the group. While some of the arguments feel a bit over the top, the twists make it worth the ride.
endingExplained: The ending reveals that the victim planned everything to make sure the bullies could not just pay their way out of trouble. The final twist shows that the parents' greed and lying actually exposed their own crimes. Most of the parents end up losing their reputations and facing legal heat. It wraps up by showing that the pain caused by bullying cannot be erased by money, leaving the survivors to deal with the ruins of their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about secrets coming out.
